SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking exceptional Electrical Engineers to join our growing team in Memphis and help design, build, and optimize on-site power generation for SpaceXAI's high-density AI supercomputing facilities. This role owns plant electrical systems for gas turbine generation — from generator, excitation, and synchronization through 34.5 kV collect/export, protection, e-houses, blackstart, and switching.

You will collaborate across electrical, mechanical, power systems, and construction teams to deliver reliable, massive-scale generation. This is a full-time, onsite role based in the Memphis region.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own plant electrical systems for on-site gas turbine generation supporting AI superclusters, including generators, excitation, synchronization, auxiliaries, and balance-of-plant electrical
• Design and engineer 34.5 kV collect and export systems, protection and control, e-houses, blackstart capability, and related medium-voltage infrastructure
• Serve as switching authority for plant electrical systems, including switching procedures, isolation, clearance, and energization
• Develop single-line diagrams, protection & control schematics, relay settings, and interconnection designs
• Perform detailed power system studies (load flow, short circuit, arc flash, transient stability, harmonics) using ETAP, PSS/E, or equivalent tools
• Integrate generation with plant systems, 34.5 kV collect/export, and downstream data center loads
• Ensure compliance with relevant standards (NERC, ERCOT, IEEE, NEC, NFPA, UL) and support permitting and utility coordination
• Support equipment specification, vendor selection, factory testing, site commissioning, and energization
• Conduct failure mode analysis (FMEA), root cause investigations, and reliability modeling to achieve extreme uptime targets
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams on new facility builds, capacity expansions, and continuous improvement of power standard

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, physics or electrical engineering technology

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience with gas turbine generators, excitation, synchronization, islanded operation, and blackstart
• Experience owning plant electrical systems, including 34.5 kV collect/export, protection, e-houses, and switching authority
• Background with data centers, hyperscale facilities, or large on-site power infrastructure (>50 MW)
• Knowledge of ERCOT, NERC reliability standards, and utility interconnection processes
• Experience supporting construction, commissioning, and operations of power systems
• Track record of innovation or high-impact delivery in power infrastructure projects

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights
• Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed; flexibility required
• Remain focused while working in hazardous environments, while wearing appropriate PPE
• Must be able to lift up to 25lbs unassisted
• Travel up to 50% to other locations
• Valid driver’s license

jobs.description: We're building an AI-native marketing organization — one where information flows through intentional systems rather than ad-hoc effort, where institutional knowledge is accessible without asking someone, and where a distributed org can stay aligned. We need a marketing communications expert to architect that future through well-crafted communications and systems — bringing our marketing org together around our shared vision and business priorities. To engage and inspire our marketing org, you'll develop the communications strategy, including town halls and narratives, crafting org change announcements, and producing a weekly digest while simultaneously building the channels, governance, and automation that make those outputs sustainable and scalable over time. This is a hybrid of creator and systems architect. You produce high-quality communications — leadership narratives, org announcements, digests, cascades — and you build the infrastructure that makes that production repeatable, measurable, and increasingly automated. Your starting questions are: Who needs to know this? How will they find out? How should it be positioned for that medium? And should this be pushed to people, or should it be available for them to pull when they need it? Then you both craft the communication and build the mechanism so it's easier next time. The expectation is that you produce and architect from the start — crafting high-quality communications while building the systems that make each subsequent one faster. Over time, the mechanisms carry more of the routine load, freeing you to focus on work that requires real craft: high-stakes narratives, sensitive changes, and strategic storytelling that can't be templatized. Key job responsibilities Communications Production - Write, produce, and deliver leadership communications — town hall scripts, org announcements, program milestone messages, and change narratives - Produce recurring communications — weekly/biweekly digests, leadership roundups, and program updates - Craft communications that respect the medium: you design for the format and you write for the audience. - Partner with the VP and Directors on what the org hears, when, through which channel, and from whom — you own the editorial calendar and deliver against it Audience Architecture & Channel Governance - Own and operate the organization's primary communication channels: the org-wide Slack channel, the VP-level distribution alias (500+ recipients), and the sub-channel ecosystem across multiple marketing sub-orgs - Design the audience map: who needs to know what, how granular does segmentation need to be, and which channels serve which audiences - Establish and enforce governance for each channel — what belongs where, posting cadence, who has send access, signal-to-noise standards - Audit and rationalize existing distribution lists, aliases, and channels — eliminate redundancy, close dead channels, ensure coverage without overload Storytelling & Content Strategy - Own the narrative strategy for the org: tell the story of what's happening here — new programs, operating model changes, cultural shifts — in a way that builds understanding and forward momentum - Develop frameworks for format selection: when to use a Slack post vs. email vs. All Hands topic vs. async video vs. wiki update - Create templates and playbooks that enable Directors and program leads to self-serve on routine communications — while you own the high-stakes, high-craft pieces - Balance the "communication mix" — leadership messages, program updates, cultural moments, operational information — so the org isn't drowning or starving Mechanisms & Automation - Build the systems that make recurring communications self-sustaining: automated distribution, templated formats, scheduled cadences - Implement AI-native approaches where appropriate — automated drafting for routine comms, intelligent routing, content personalization by audience segment - Own measurement: engagement signals, feedback loops, read-through indicators that tell you what's landing and what's noise - Every piece of work you produce should leave behind infrastructure: a template, a channel improvement, a governance rule. The work compounds. Pull Systems & Organizational Knowledge - Own the "pull" side of communications — making organizational knowledge accessible so people can find what they need, when they need it, without waiting for someone to push it to them - Ensure org knowledge stays current and discoverable as the org evolves — not through manual upkeep, but through systems that make freshness the default - Design the information experience for self-service: who we are, what we do, how to navigate, where to find decisions. The format may be a wiki, a knowledge base, or something new Scaled Leadership Communications - Produce All Hands meetings, town halls, and org-wide announcements in partnership with the VP and leadership team - Own the development of communication strategies and messaging for all major org comms: structural changes, leadership announcements, program milestones - Partner with HR on communications that require coordinated, sensitive messaging You are: - A producer and architect: You write the town hall narrative and build the system that makes next quarter's town hall faster to produce. You don't choose between doing the work and building the infrastructure — you do both, and every piece of output leaves behind something reusable. - An audience-first communicator: Your instinct isn't "what do I write?" — it's "who needs to know, how will they find out, and what does this need to be in that medium?" You start with the human on the receiving end and work backward. - A storyteller with range: You can write a sensitive org change announcement that lands with clarity instead of anxiety, a scannable digest that people actually read, and a town hall arc that holds attention for 45 minutes. You adapt your craft to the format — not everything is a memo. - AI-native: You use AI to accelerate production, automate distribution, and measure impact. You have a point of view on what should be mechanized (routine digests, distribution, measurement) vs. what requires human craft (narrative framing, sensitive messaging, audience design). - Governance-minded: You understand that communication channels need intentional design to stay valuable at scale. You establish clear guidelines, make them easy to follow, and evolve them as the org grows. - Comfortable across altitudes: You partner with the VP on the narrative strategy for a major org change and produce the Slack post that announces it on Monday morning. - Organizationally fluent: You quickly map how an org actually works — where information bottlenecks, which channels are dead weight, where tribal knowledge lives. You see informal flows, not just the org chart.

We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Our team owns the partner onboarding and experience domain within PayPal’s Payment Services & Crypto Engineering organization. We build and operate the platforms that bring merchants and partners onto PayPal and serve them across their entire lifecycle — from first sign-up through the day-to-day work of running their business. It spans 200+ markets, 15 banking licenses, 40+ products, and more than 200,000 combinations of country, product, license, and data-field requirements — each with local risk, compliance, tax, and legal nuances. Our mission is to make that complexity invisible: to merchants, to partners, and to the engineers who build on our platform. EOP replaces flow-by-flow, hard-wired experiences with dynamic, just-in-time UI driven by downstream risk and compliance requirements. Business logic is centralized in a server-side orchestration mid-tier (Merchant Onboarding Management), keeping front-end experiences lightweight. The platform supports web, mobile, API, and webhook integration models and integrates in real time with the Salesforce CRM platform to onboard high-value merchants and partners. Merchant Servicing Platform The platform that supports merchants once they are live — wallet, profile, settings, preferences, configuration, and transaction history. We are extending servicing beyond the UI to offer APIs and webhooks as first-class servicing experiences, especially for partners managing merchants on their own platforms, across all merchant segments from SMB through Large Enterprise. You will write high-quality Java code, build resilient RESTful services and batch workflows on the Spring ecosystem, and a decent front-end foundation who is equally comfortable building rich, dynamic user experiences and the services behind them. You will craft the customer-facing web experiences that power merchant and partner onboarding and servicing, and work down the stack into the microservices, APIs, and batch workflows that drive them, This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys owning a feature end to end — from UI to API to data — and collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to deliver features that thousands of merchants and partners depend on every day. Implement microservices architecture, ensuring modularity, scalability, and maintainability. Conduct rigorous code reviews and debugging, and develop automated tests to verify software functionality and performance. Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, Java services, and batch processing jobs using the Spring Framework (including Spring MVC and Spring Boot/Batch where applicable) to support scalable enterprise applications. Develop dynamic, data-driven UIs that render just-in-time based on downstream risk, compliance, and product requirements, keeping the front-end lightweight and free of business logic. Optimize front-end performance (load time, rendering, customer-perceived latency) and ensure cross-browser and cross-device consistency, including mobile web. Familiarity with core computer science concepts such as data structures, algorithms, software design principles, object-oriented programming, and relational database concepts. Knowledge of building and optimizing data storage solutions and managing cloud infrastructure for high availability and performance. Proficient in Java and the Spring ecosystem, with experience building REST APIs, web services, scalable microservices, and batch workflows. Familiarity with programming for data processing and automation to complement Java-based Spring applications. Experience building responsive, accessible (WCAG-aware) UIs and consuming RESTful APIs and webhooks from the front end. jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Machine Shop Engineer to own and operate the rapid prototyping shop at our Boston Development Center. As the leader for precision fabrication and additive manufacturing, you own end-to-end execution of machined and 3D-printed components that drive our hardware development. This is a prototype shop: short-run, high-mix. Most jobs are unique, every setup matters, and the engineering team's development velocity depends on what leaves the shop each week. You will manage the full scope of shop operations, multi-axis CNC milling and turning, manual/conventional machining, and industrial 3D printing (metal and polymer). You will hire and develop a team of CNC programmers, precision machinists, and additive manufacturing technicians, set the schedule, and work directly with design and manufacturing engineers to keep first-piece quality high and turnaround tight. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who came up through programming and machining and is still credible at the CAM seat and on the shop floor. Key job responsibilities - Own day-to-day machine shop operations end-to-end: job scheduling, work prioritization, resource allocation, and throughput management across CNC machining and additive manufacturing equipment. - Hire, develop, and manage a team of CNC machinists, CNC programmers, and additive manufacturing technicians. Set performance expectations, coach development, and hold the team accountable for safety, quality, and delivery. - Manage job queues across multiple concurrent engineering programs, prioritize work to maximize throughput and minimize lead time, balancing urgent R&D prototype requests with operational tooling and fixture needs. Implement job routing and tracking workflows to manage the high-mix, rapid-turnaround queue. - Work directly with product design and manufacturing engineers to review part designs, advise on manufacturability (DFM), select machining strategies, and ensure first-piece quality meets drawing requirements. - Oversee CNC programming (CAM), setup verification, first-piece inspection, in-process checks, tool offsets, and changeovers. Troubleshoot machining issues related to programming, tooling, workholding, dimensional variation, and surface finish. - Manage 3D printing / additive manufacturing operations, job scheduling, material management, build parameter optimization, and post-processing for both metal and polymer systems. - Drive performance metrics: on-time delivery, first-piece quality, throughput, machine utilization, scrap rate. Use data to identify improvement opportunities and report shop performance to leadership. - Ensure safety and housekeeping standards are maintained, 5S, PPE compliance, machine guarding, and EHS requirements for a machining and additive manufacturing environment. - Own equipment maintenance, calibration, and uptime. Evaluate and recommend capital expenditure for new machines, tooling, fixtures, and measurement equipment as the shop scales.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This is an in-country role.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced General Manager who has successfully built and led sales and technical teams. The GM will be responsible for the overall country strategy and deliverables, in line with the company priorities. We are looking for an execution-focused operator who can propel ElevenLabs in the country. As part of the role, you will:

- Develop and execute our Country strategy, including sales, customer delivery, KPI setting and hiring

- Design the optimal pipeline to reach our ambitious sales targets in the B2B side. In this sense, you will be expected to lead interactions with the top 30 strategic accounts in the market

- Hire the founding country team responsible for sales and implementations

- Define event priorities and where to invest for brand awareness

- Represent ElevenLabs in events and media appearances

- Work with the partner ecosystem to generate new collaborations and sales opportunities, in partnership with the global BD team

- Ideate, own and drive big bets in the country

REQUIREMENTS

- 15+ years of experience leading teams and highly complex projects

- Background in consulting and sales

- Deep expertise in deploying technical products and/or solutions to enterprises

- Owner mentality. Hands-on and self-starter who is keen to get their hands dirty to produce results

- Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

- A hands-on leader who thinks outside the box and wants to generate results

- Proven ability to build and scale high-performing teams

- Native speaker of the local language

LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Mexico with the ability to travel to be on-site with clients, primarily in Mexico City.
